exposure: Preferences of birth by caesarean section
cohort: Women under 40 years old, attending university, not pregnant nor had been pregnant but wished for at least one child in the future
finding: Women born outside of New Zealand and/or suffering 'severe' depression were more likely to have a fear of birth, and fear of birth was associated with preferences towards medicalised childbirth.
mod_finding: Preference for caesarean section was associated with higher fear of birth scores.
